function_signature: BodyPtr api_combine_bodies(const BodyList& bodies, bool clone = true)
behavior: Combine target and tool BodyPtr inputs into one BodyPtr while optionally cloning the inputs.
smoke_guidance: Use two separated solid spheres and require exactly one valid result body with finite nonnegative properties.

topotrack.reason: The API returns BodyPtr and exposes no ModelingRet TopoTrack channel.
